scorecard: Management’s promises consistently overshoot the financial reality – two testable targets were missed and the rest remain untrackable or pending.
business: Tata Power is an integrated power generation, transmission and distribution company operating across thermal, hydro, solar and wind assets in India. It also runs a distribution business serving millions of customers and a growing rooftop solar segment.
bull: Revenue rose 26% YoY to ₹19,636 cr in Q2 FY27
EBITDA margin stayed above 19% in Q2 FY27
PAT climbed to ₹1,652 cr, an 18% YoY increase in Q2 FY27
bear: EBITDA margin fell to 17% in Q4 FY26
Revenue slipped 13% YoY in Q1 FY27
FY26 capex was ₹14,129 cr, well below the ₹25,000 cr target
